blocks.zh: 學習目標 Learning Objectives
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解大規模氣態去污（VPHP、二氧化氯、臭氧、濕霧法）的作用機制、適用場景與操作條件，並能區分「去污」與「清潔」的本質差異。
blocks.en: Understand the mechanism of action, applicable scenarios and operating conditions of large-scale gaseous decontamination (VPHP, chlorine dioxide, ozone, wet fogging), and be able to distinguish decontamination from cleaning.

blocks.zh: 掌握 VPHP（氣化過氧化氫）在製藥 GMP 環境中的特殊地位——從隔離器到大規模廠房應用的異同，以及驗證要求與 PtC-12 的互補關係。
blocks.en: Grasp the special position of VPHP (vaporized hydrogen peroxide) in pharmaceutical GMP environments, including the similarities and differences between isolator and large-scale room applications, and how validation requirements complement PtC-12.

blocks.zh: 熟悉 TR70 引用之核心法規（FDA 無菌製造指引、EU GMP Annex 1、USP <1072>、ISO 14644/14698）及重要參考文獻，能在實際 C&D 程序設計中引用正確依據。
blocks.en: Become familiar with the core regulations cited in TR70 (FDA aseptic processing guidance, EU GMP Annex 1, USP <1072>, ISO 14644/14698) and key references, so that the correct basis can be cited when designing actual C&D procedures.

blocks.zh: 本節內容 Contents
blocks.en: Contents

blocks.zh: 重點解析
blocks.en: Key Points

blocks.zh: 大規模氣態去污 vs. 例行清潔/消毒
blocks.en: Large-Scale Gaseous Decontamination vs. Routine Cleaning/Disinfection

blocks.zh: TR70 把大規模氣態去污視為「特殊事件工具」而非日常程序替代品：
blocks.en: TR70 treats large-scale gaseous decontamination as a "special-event tool" rather than a substitute for routine procedures:

blocks.zh: 觸發情境：設施翻修後復歸使用、發生重大微生物汙染事件（positive EM event）、全廠停產後重啟
blocks.en: Trigger situations: return to use after facility renovation, a major microbial contamination event (positive EM event), restart after a plant-wide shutdown

blocks.zh: 補充關係：去污在清潔之前或之後都可進行，但不能取代機械性清潔（擦拭、拖地）
blocks.en: Complementary relationship: decontamination can be performed before or after cleaning, but it cannot replace mechanical cleaning (wiping, mopping)

blocks.zh: CDMO 應用：客戶切換、不同產品批次之間的廠房轉換，有時需要大規模 VHP 作為額外保障
blocks.en: CDMO application: for client changeovers and room transitions between different product batches, large-scale VHP is sometimes needed as additional assurance

blocks.zh: 比喻：核武 vs. 常規武器
blocks.en: Analogy: Nuclear Weapons vs. Conventional Weapons

blocks.zh: VHP 大規模去污就像軍事上的「核選項」——威力強大，但不能取代日常的例行防護。廠房每天的擦拭消毒是常規武器；VHP 是萬不得已時才動用的重型武器。兩者角色不同，缺一不可。
blocks.en: Large-scale VHP decontamination is like the "nuclear option" in military terms: powerful, but not a replacement for everyday routine protection. Daily wipe-down disinfection of the facility is the conventional weapon; VHP is the heavy weapon deployed only as a last resort. The two roles are different, and neither can do without the other.

blocks.zh: 氣態去污劑的分類邏輯
blocks.en: Classification Logic of Gaseous Decontaminants

blocks.zh: TR70 將這些技術分成兩大類：
blocks.en: TR70 divides these technologies into two broad categories:

blocks.zh: 真氣態（gaseous）：VHP、ClO₂、臭氧、甲醛——氣體分子均勻分佈，穿透力強
blocks.en: True gaseous: VHP, ClO₂, ozone, formaldehyde. Gas molecules distribute evenly and penetrate well

blocks.zh: 濕霧（wet fogging）：微液滴（10–25 µm）物理性覆蓋表面——依賴接觸而非氣體穿透
blocks.en: Wet fogging: micro-droplets (10–25 µm) physically coat surfaces. This relies on contact rather than gas penetration

blocks.zh: 選擇哪一種取決於廠房結構、目標菌種、殘留要求及人員安全考量。
blocks.en: Which one to choose depends on room construction, target organisms, residue requirements and personnel safety considerations.

blocks.zh: 為何 GMP 廠逐漸淘汰甲醛熏蒸
blocks.en: Why GMP Facilities Are Phasing Out Formaldehyde Fumigation

blocks.zh: 甲醛熏蒸的核心問題
blocks.en: Core Problems of Formaldehyde Fumigation

blocks.zh: 表面殘留：甲醛會在所有接觸表面留下殘餘，FDA 對此有明確關切
blocks.en: Surface residue: formaldehyde leaves residues on all contacted surfaces, and FDA has expressed clear concern about this

blocks.zh: 人員健康風險：甲醛為已知致癌物（IARC Group 1），操作風險極高
blocks.en: Personnel health risk: formaldehyde is a known carcinogen (IARC Group 1), and operating risk is very high

blocks.zh: 法規壓力：歐盟及多國職安法規對甲醛暴露限值越來越嚴格
blocks.en: Regulatory pressure: EU and many national occupational safety regulations are setting increasingly strict formaldehyde exposure limits

blocks.zh: 更好的替代品已存在：VHP、ClO₂ 等技術已成熟，殘留問題更易管理
blocks.en: Better alternatives already exist: VHP, ClO₂ and similar technologies are mature, and residue issues are easier to manage

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務提醒
blocks.en: CDMO Practical Reminder

blocks.zh: 若廠房 SOP 或歷史記錄仍保有甲醛熏蒸程序，應列入設施現代化改善計畫（facility modernization）優先項目。在新設施設計時，完全不應納入甲醛熏蒸選項。
blocks.en: If facility SOPs or historical records still contain a formaldehyde fumigation procedure, it should be listed as a priority item in the facility modernization improvement plan. Formaldehyde fumigation should not be included as an option at all in the design of new facilities.

blocks.zh: 濕霧法實務解析
blocks.en: Practical Analysis of Wet Fogging

blocks.zh: 比喻：淋浴 vs. 蒸氣浴
blocks.en: Analogy: Shower vs. Steam Bath

blocks.zh: 濕霧法像「淋浴」——水霧打濕表面達到消毒目的；VHP 像「蒸氣浴」——水蒸氣無孔不入，連縫隙都能滲透。前者快速方便，後者穿透力更強但設置更複雜。
blocks.en: Wet fogging is like a "shower": a water mist wets the surface to achieve disinfection. VHP is like a "steam bath": the vapor gets everywhere and penetrates even crevices. The former is quick and convenient; the latter penetrates better but is more complex to set up.

blocks.zh: CDMO 操作注意事項
blocks.en: CDMO Operating Considerations

blocks.zh: 使用濕霧法需特別注意：
blocks.en: When using wet fogging, pay particular attention to the following:

blocks.zh: 操作人員在液霧濃度未降至容許暴露限值前，不得進入廠房
blocks.en: Operators must not enter the room until the mist concentration has dropped below the permissible exposure limit

blocks.zh: 過度使用且缺乏機械清潔，會造成 QAC 殘留累積（resistance selection pressure）
blocks.en: Overuse without mechanical cleaning leads to accumulation of QAC residues (resistance selection pressure)

blocks.zh: 每次噴霧結束後，所有未完全乾燥的表面應人工輔助擦乾，但需穿戴適當個人防護裝備
blocks.en: After each fogging cycle, all surfaces that are not completely dry should be wiped dry manually, with appropriate personal protective equipment worn

blocks.zh: VHP 深度解析
blocks.en: In-Depth Analysis of VHP

blocks.zh: VHP（氣化過氧化氫）核心概念
blocks.en: Core Concepts of VHP (Vaporized Hydrogen Peroxide)

blocks.zh: VHP / VPHP (Vaporized Hydrogen Peroxide，氣化過氧化氫) 是目前製藥 GMP 環境中最主流的大規模氣態去污技術。
blocks.en: VHP / VPHP (Vaporized Hydrogen Peroxide) is currently the most mainstream large-scale gaseous decontamination technology in pharmaceutical GMP environments.

blocks.zh: 作用原理：H₂O₂ 蒸氣釋放自由基（•OH），破壞細胞膜、DNA 及蛋白質
blocks.en: Mechanism of action: H₂O₂ vapor releases free radicals (•OH) that damage cell membranes, DNA and proteins

blocks.zh: 殺菌能力：可達 6-log 殺滅芽孢（Geobacillus stearothermophilus），是無菌製造廠最重要的去污工具
blocks.en: Biocidal capability: can achieve a 6-log kill of spores (Geobacillus stearothermophilus), making it the most important decontamination tool for sterile manufacturing facilities

blocks.zh: 殘留優勢：最終分解為 H₂O + O₂，無有毒殘留，符合 FDA 對殘留的要求
blocks.en: Residue advantage: ultimately breaks down into H₂O + O₂ with no toxic residue, meeting FDA expectations on residues

blocks.zh: 濃度範圍：250–1,200 ppm（視目標殺滅等級而定）
blocks.en: Concentration range: 250–1,200 ppm (depending on the target kill level)

blocks.zh: VHP 循環四階段（Cycle Phases）
blocks.en: The Four Phases of a VHP Cycle

blocks.zh:
1. 去濕（Dehumidification）
   → 降低相對濕度，防止 H₂O₂ 提前凝結

2. 充裝（Conditioning）
   → 開始注入 H₂O₂ 蒸氣，濃度逐漸上升

3. 暴露（Exposure）
   → 維持目標濃度（ppm）× 時間（min）
   → 生物指示劑（BI）置於最難達到的位置

4. 充氣復原（Aeration）
   → 通入過濾空氣，將 H₂O₂ 分解至安全濃度
   → 通常需 2–4 小時
blocks.en:
1. Dehumidification
   → Lower the relative humidity to prevent premature condensation of H₂O₂

2. Conditioning
   → Begin injecting H₂O₂ vapor; concentration rises gradually

3. Exposure
   → Maintain the target concentration (ppm) × time (min)
   → Biological indicators (BI) placed at the most difficult-to-reach locations

4. Aeration
   → Introduce filtered air to break H₂O₂ down to a safe concentration
   → Typically takes 2–4 hours

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務：TR70 與 PtC-12 的互補關係
blocks.en: CDMO Practice: How TR70 and PtC-12 Complement Each Other

blocks.zh: TR70（本文件）提供整體 C&D 框架脈絡：VHP 在廠房層次的定位、適用場景、與清潔程序的關係。
blocks.en: TR70 (this document) provides the overall C&D framework and context: the position of VHP at room level, applicable scenarios, and its relationship to cleaning procedures.

blocks.zh: PtC-12（RABS 及隔離器）則提供隔離器 VHP 去污的具體指引：循環開發、生物指示劑放置策略、D 值計算、參數化放行（parametric release）。
blocks.en: PtC-12 (RABS and Isolators) provides specific guidance on isolator VHP decontamination: cycle development, biological indicator placement strategy, D-value calculation and parametric release.

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 日常運作中，設計隔離器 VHP SOP 時，應同時參照兩份文件——TR70 提供「為什麼」，PtC-12 提供「怎麼做」。
blocks.en: In day-to-day CDMO operations, when designing an isolator VHP SOP, both documents should be consulted: TR70 provides the "why" and PtC-12 provides the "how".

blocks.zh: ClO₂ 與臭氧的定位
blocks.en: Positioning of ClO₂ and Ozone

blocks.zh: TR70 的視角：技術選擇框架
blocks.en: TR70 Perspective: A Framework for Technology Selection

blocks.zh: TR70 對 ClO₂ 和臭氧的描述較 VHP 簡略，暗示這兩種技術在 2015 年時仍處於「考慮中」（being considered）的階段。選擇大規模去污技術時，需從以下維度評估：
blocks.en: TR70 describes ClO₂ and ozone more briefly than VHP, implying that in 2015 these two technologies were still "being considered". When selecting a large-scale decontamination technology, evaluate it along the following dimensions:

blocks.zh: 腐蝕性（不鏽鋼、電子設備的兼容性）
blocks.en: Corrosiveness (compatibility with stainless steel and electronic equipment)

blocks.zh: 殘留風險（藥品接觸面、患者安全）
blocks.en: Residue risk (product-contact surfaces, patient safety)

blocks.zh: 人員安全（容許暴露限值 PEL）
blocks.en: Personnel safety (permissible exposure limit, PEL)

blocks.zh: 設置複雜度（發生器、散佈系統）
blocks.en: Setup complexity (generators, distribution system)

blocks.zh: 驗證數據的可取得性
blocks.en: Availability of validation data

blocks.zh: 安全與驗證：CDMO 必須遵守的底線
blocks.en: Safety and Validation: The Baseline a CDMO Must Meet

blocks.zh: 大規模去污的驗證最低要求
blocks.en: Minimum Validation Requirements for Large-Scale Decontamination

blocks.zh: TR70 雖未詳細列出驗證方案，但以下要素是業界共識：
blocks.en: Although TR70 does not list a detailed validation program, the following elements are industry consensus:

blocks.zh: 生物指示劑（BI）：Geobacillus stearothermophilus 芽孢，≥10⁶ 初始菌數，目標 6-log 殺滅
blocks.en: Biological indicators (BI): Geobacillus stearothermophilus spores, ≥10⁶ initial population, targeting a 6-log kill

blocks.zh: 暴露地圖（exposure mapping）：在廠房最難到達位置（死角、設備後方、角落）放置 BI 和化學指示劑
blocks.en: Exposure mapping: place BIs and chemical indicators at the most difficult-to-reach locations in the room (dead spots, behind equipment, corners)

blocks.zh: 濃度驗證：使用 H₂O₂ 感測器或化學指示劑確認全廠房濃度均勻分佈
blocks.en: Concentration verification: use H₂O₂ sensors or chemical indicators to confirm that the concentration is evenly distributed throughout the room

blocks.zh: 材料相容性：確認廠房建材、設備表面可承受去污劑而無損壞
blocks.en: Material compatibility: confirm that room construction materials and equipment surfaces can withstand the decontaminant without damage

blocks.zh: 殘留測試：確認去污後產品接觸面的殘留量符合規範
blocks.en: Residue testing: confirm that residue levels on product-contact surfaces after decontamination meet specifications

blocks.zh: 洩漏測試：確認去污劑不會外洩至其他區域或走廊
blocks.en: Leak testing: confirm that the decontaminant does not escape into other areas or corridors

blocks.zh: 根本原因分析先於去污
blocks.en: Root Cause Analysis Before Decontamination

blocks.zh: TR70 強調：大規模去污只能消滅「現有」的微生物，但如果污染源（如設施缺陷、人員操作問題、設備損壞）未被消除，去污後水分殘留反而可能造成更大規模的微生物增殖。
blocks.en: TR70 emphasizes that large-scale decontamination can only eliminate the "existing" microorganisms. If the source of contamination (such as facility defects, personnel practice problems or equipment damage) has not been eliminated, residual moisture after decontamination may instead lead to even greater microbial proliferation.

blocks.zh: 正確順序：找出並消除污染源 → 清潔 → 去污 → 環境監測確認。
blocks.en: Correct sequence: identify and eliminate the contamination source → clean → decontaminate → confirm with environmental monitoring.

blocks.zh: 思考練習：你的廠房 VHP 程序完整嗎？
blocks.en: Exercise: Is Your Facility's VHP Program Complete?

blocks.zh: VHP 循環是否有完整的驗證報告（含 BI 結果、暴露地圖）？
blocks.en: Does the VHP cycle have a complete validation report (including BI results and exposure mapping)?

blocks.zh: 操作 SOP 是否涵蓋人員安全、HVAC 封閉程序、釋放標準？
blocks.en: Does the operating SOP cover personnel safety, HVAC isolation procedures and release criteria?

blocks.zh: VHP 後是否有確認程序（EM sampling）驗證去污效果？
blocks.en: Is there a confirmation step after VHP (EM sampling) to verify decontamination effectiveness?

blocks.zh: VHP 前的機械清潔是否有文件記錄？
blocks.en: Is mechanical cleaning before VHP documented?

blocks.zh: 廠房建材的 VHP 相容性是否已評估？
blocks.en: Has the VHP compatibility of room construction materials been evaluated?

blocks.zh: 關鍵參考文獻解析
blocks.en: Analysis of Key References

blocks.zh: 核心監管文件層次（Ref. 3–8）
blocks.en: Hierarchy of Core Regulatory Documents (Ref. 3–8)

blocks.zh: TR70 的監管框架建立在三個主要法規體系之上：
blocks.en: The regulatory framework of TR70 is built on three major regulatory systems:

blocks.zh: 美國：21 CFR 211.42(c)（設施要求）+ FDA 2004 無菌製造指引（最核心的 GMP 依據）
blocks.en: United States: 21 CFR 211.42(c) (facility requirements) + FDA 2004 aseptic processing guidance (the most central GMP basis)

blocks.zh: 歐盟：EU GMP Annex 1（無菌製藥製造）+ Chapter 3（廠房設備）+ Chapter 5（生產）——三份文件共同建構 EU GMP C&D 要求
blocks.en: European Union: EU GMP Annex 1 (Manufacture of Sterile Medicinal Products) + Chapter 3 (Premises and Equipment) + Chapter 5 (Production). Together these three documents make up the EU GMP C&D requirements

blocks.zh: 國際：PIC/S PE 009-11（各國互認的 GMP 基準）
blocks.en: International: PIC/S PE 009-11 (the GMP benchmark mutually recognized across countries)

blocks.zh: 注意：本 TR70 引用的是 2008 年版 EU GMP Annex 1。2022 年已發布重大修訂版，對 C&D 的要求更為明確，CDMO 應以新版為準。
blocks.en: Note: this TR70 cites the 2008 version of EU GMP Annex 1. A major revision was published in 2022 with clearer C&D requirements, and CDMOs should work to the new version.

blocks.zh: USP <1072> 的地位（Ref. 9）
blocks.en: The Status of USP <1072> (Ref. 9)

blocks.zh: USP General Chapter <1072> 消毒劑與防腐劑 是美國藥典對消毒劑使用的指引性章節（非強制執行）。它提供：
blocks.en: USP General Chapter <1072> Disinfectants and Antiseptics is the US Pharmacopeia's guidance chapter on the use of disinfectants (not mandatory). It provides:

blocks.zh: 消毒劑分類與選用標準
blocks.en: Classification of disinfectants and selection criteria

blocks.zh: 效力測試方法指引
blocks.en: Guidance on efficacy testing methods

blocks.zh: 消毒劑輪換（rotation）的理論依據
blocks.en: The theoretical rationale for disinfectant rotation

blocks.zh: CDMO 應在 C&D 程序文件中引用此章節作為支持性依據。
blocks.en: CDMOs should cite this chapter in C&D procedure documents as supporting rationale.

blocks.zh: ISO 14698 的角色（Ref. 11）
blocks.en: The Role of ISO 14698 (Ref. 11)

blocks.zh: ISO 14698 潔淨室生物污染控制 提供環境微生物監測的國際標準框架。TR70 引用此標準以確立：C&D 程序與 EM 程序（環境監測）必須作為一個整合系統運作。消毒效果的驗證，最終要反映在 EM 數據的改善上。
blocks.en: ISO 14698 Cleanrooms and associated controlled environments: Biocontamination control provides an international standard framework for environmental microbial monitoring. TR70 cites this standard to establish that C&D procedures and EM (environmental monitoring) procedures must operate as one integrated system. The ultimate proof of disinfection effectiveness is an improvement in EM data.

blocks.zh: 歷史文獻的意義（Ref. 16–19）
blocks.en: Significance of the Historical Literature (Ref. 16–19)

blocks.zh: TR70 引用 Robert Koch 1881 年的消毒學著作和 1903 年 Rideal-Walker 標準化方法，顯示消毒科學的現代框架直接源自 19 世紀微生物學奠基者。這些引用不只是學術致敬——它們提醒我們：消毒的基本原理（接觸時間、濃度、菌種特異性）百年來沒有本質改變，只是材料和技術演進了。
blocks.en: TR70 cites Robert Koch's 1881 work on disinfection and the 1903 Rideal-Walker standardized method, showing that the modern framework of disinfection science derives directly from the founders of 19th-century microbiology. These citations are more than an academic tribute: they remind us that the basic principles of disinfection (contact time, concentration, organism specificity) have not changed in essence in a hundred years; only materials and technology have evolved.

blocks.zh: EPA 登記架構（Ref. 20–23）
blocks.en: EPA Registration Framework (Ref. 20–23)

blocks.zh: FIFRA、CFR Title 40 和 EPA Label Review Manual 共同構成美國消毒劑上市許可的法律框架。CDMO 需確認所用消毒劑均具有適當 EPA 登記號碼，且使用方法符合標籤說明（use as labeled）——這是 FDA 查廠時的常見查核點。
blocks.en: FIFRA, CFR Title 40 and the EPA Label Review Manual together form the legal framework for marketing authorization of disinfectants in the United States. A CDMO needs to confirm that every disinfectant used has an appropriate EPA registration number and that the method of use conforms to the label instructions (use as labeled). This is a common checkpoint during FDA inspections.

blocks.zh: 延伸閱讀重點推薦
blocks.en: Recommended Further Reading

blocks.zh: 第一優先：Block 教科書（Suggested Reading #4）
blocks.en: First priority: the Block textbook (Suggested Reading #4)

blocks.zh: Disinfection, Sterilization and Preservation（Block 主編，Lippincott W&W, 5th ed.）是消毒科學最重要的參考書籍，涵蓋所有消毒劑的化學機制、抗藥性機制、測試方法及應用。凡從事製藥環境 C&D 工作者，此書應為案頭必備。
blocks.en: Disinfection, Sterilization and Preservation (Block, Ed., Lippincott W&W, 5th ed.) is the most important reference book in disinfection science, covering the chemical mechanisms, resistance mechanisms, test methods and applications of all disinfectants. Anyone working on pharmaceutical environment C&D should keep it on their desk.

blocks.zh: 第二優先：McDonnell & Russell 抗藥性論文（SR #22）
blocks.en: Second priority: the McDonnell & Russell paper on resistance (SR #22)

blocks.zh: McDonnell & Russell 的 Clin. Microbiol. Rev. 1999 年論文是理解消毒劑抗藥性最被廣泛引用的文獻之一。對 CDMO 而言，理解抗藥性機制是設計消毒劑輪換計畫（rotation program）的科學基礎。
blocks.en: McDonnell & Russell's 1999 paper in Clin. Microbiol. Rev. is one of the most widely cited references for understanding disinfectant resistance. For a CDMO, understanding resistance mechanisms is the scientific basis for designing a disinfectant rotation program.

blocks.zh: 第三優先：Polarine et al. — 氣態去污整合方案（SR #25）
blocks.en: Third priority: Polarine et al., an integrated approach to gaseous decontamination (SR #25)

blocks.zh: Cleanrooms Magazine 2010 年 Polarine 等人的文章（Cleaning, Disinfection and Gaseous Decontamination）提供了最接近 CDMO 實際操作情境的整合方案——將機械清潔、化學消毒和 VHP 三個層次整合為一套完整的微生物控制策略，高度實用。
blocks.en: The 2010 article by Polarine et al. in Cleanrooms Magazine (Cleaning, Disinfection and Gaseous Decontamination) offers the integrated approach closest to real CDMO operating situations. It combines three tiers (mechanical cleaning, chemical disinfection and VHP) into one complete microbial control strategy, and is highly practical.

blocks.zh: 建議閱讀順序（初學者）
blocks.en: Suggested Reading Order (Beginners)

blocks.zh: Madigan et al., Brock Biology of Microorganisms — 建立微生物基礎知識
blocks.en: Madigan et al., Brock Biology of Microorganisms: builds foundational microbiology knowledge

blocks.zh: McDonnell & Russell 1999 — 理解消毒劑作用與抗藥性
blocks.en: McDonnell & Russell 1999: understand disinfectant action and resistance

blocks.zh: Block (Ed.) — 深入各類消毒劑機制
blocks.en: Block (Ed.): go deeper into the mechanisms of each class of disinfectant

blocks.zh: Moldenhauer, Environmental Monitoring Handbook — 連結 C&D 與 EM 程序
blocks.en: Moldenhauer, Environmental Monitoring Handbook: links C&D with EM procedures

blocks.zh: Polarine 2010 — 整合理論與 GMP 實務
blocks.en: Polarine 2010: integrates theory with GMP practice

blocks.zh: EN 標準 vs. AOAC 方法：歐美雙軌
blocks.en: EN Standards vs. AOAC Methods: The Dual EU/US Track

blocks.zh: 延伸閱讀中同時引用了 EN（歐洲標準）和 AOAC（美國方法），反映了 TR70 的全球視野。CDMO 若服務歐美兩地的客戶，需熟悉兩套測試標準：
blocks.en: The further reading cites both EN (European standards) and AOAC (US methods), reflecting the global perspective of TR70. A CDMO serving clients in both Europe and the US needs to be familiar with both sets of test standards:

blocks.zh: AOAC 方法：美國 EPA 登記必要，以 log kill 為標準
blocks.en: AOAC methods: required for US EPA registration, with log kill as the standard

blocks.zh: EN 標準：EU GMP 環境，三階段（懸浮、表面、現場）測試框架
blocks.en: EN standards: for the EU GMP environment, a three-phase (suspension, surface, field) test framework

blocks.zh: TR70 整體綜合總結 — 製藥 CDMO 的完整 C&D 程序全貌
blocks.en: Overall Summary of TR70: The Complete Picture of a CDMO's C&D Program

blocks.zh: PDA TR70 (2015) 橫跨 75 頁、9 大主題，建構了無菌製造設施清潔與消毒程序的完整知識框架。以下是從 CDMO 視角對全報告的整合性總結。
blocks.en: PDA TR70 (2015) spans 75 pages and 9 major topics, building a complete knowledge framework for cleaning and disinfection procedures in aseptic manufacturing facilities. What follows is an integrated summary of the whole report from a CDMO perspective.

blocks.zh: 基礎框架（Sections 1–4）
blocks.en: Foundation Framework (Sections 1–4)

blocks.zh: C&D 的科學根基：微生物形態、消毒劑作用機制、污染途徑
blocks.en: Scientific basis of C&D: microbial morphology, mechanisms of action of disinfectants, contamination routes

blocks.zh: 微生物抗藥性：適應性 vs. 真實抗藥性，輪換的科學依據
blocks.en: Microbial resistance: adaptation vs. true resistance, and the scientific basis for rotation

blocks.zh: 程序設計三要素：選藥、驗證、訓練
blocks.en: Three elements of procedure design: selection, validation, training

blocks.zh: 核心文件：SOP、驗證報告、偏差處理
blocks.en: Core documents: SOPs, validation reports, deviation handling

blocks.zh: 消毒劑選用（Sections 5–6 + Appendices）
blocks.en: Disinfectant Selection (Sections 5–6 + Appendices)

blocks.zh: 四大類消毒劑：酒精、QAC、含鹵素、過氧化物/過乙酸
blocks.en: Four major classes of disinfectants: alcohols, QACs, halogen-containing agents, peroxides/peracetic acid

blocks.zh: 孢子殺滅劑（sporicides）：芽孢專用，最高殺菌等級
blocks.en: Sporicides: specific for spores, the highest level of antimicrobial activity

blocks.zh: EPA 登記要求（美國）vs. EN 標準（歐盟）
blocks.en: EPA registration requirements (US) vs. EN standards (EU)

blocks.zh: 個人防護裝備（PPE）與安全數據表（SDS）義務
blocks.en: Obligations for personal protective equipment (PPE) and safety data sheets (SDS)

blocks.zh: 程序執行（Sections 7–12）
blocks.en: Procedure Execution (Sections 7–12)

blocks.zh: 廠房分區清潔：ISO 5 核心區 → ISO 7/8 走廊的層次化管理
blocks.en: Zoned room cleaning: tiered management from the ISO 5 core area to ISO 7/8 corridors

blocks.zh: 排程與頻率：基於 EM 數據的風險分級
blocks.en: Scheduling and frequency: risk grading based on EM data

blocks.zh: 設備與器具的清潔驗證
blocks.en: Cleaning validation of equipment and utensils

blocks.zh: 環境監測（EM）作為 C&D 有效性的最終驗證指標
blocks.en: Environmental monitoring (EM) as the ultimate indicator of C&D effectiveness

blocks.zh: 進階技術（Appendices V–VIII）
blocks.en: Advanced Technologies (Appendices V–VIII)

blocks.zh: Appendix V：EPA 安全標示要求
blocks.en: Appendix V: EPA safety labeling requirements

blocks.zh: Appendix VI：AOAC 方法 — 美國 EPA 登記用
blocks.en: Appendix VI: AOAC methods, used for US EPA registration

blocks.zh: Appendix VII：EN 測試 — 歐盟登記用（Phase 1/2/3）
blocks.en: Appendix VII: EN tests, used for EU registration (Phase 1/2/3)

blocks.zh: Appendix VIII：大規模氣態去污（VHP、ClO₂、臭氧、濕霧法）
blocks.en: Appendix VIII: Large-scale gaseous decontamination (VHP, ClO₂, ozone, wet fogging)

blocks.zh: VHP 的特殊地位
blocks.en: The Special Position of VHP

blocks.zh: 最接近「廠房層次滅菌」的工具：6-log 芽孢殺滅能力
blocks.en: The tool closest to "room-level sterilization": 6-log spore kill capability

blocks.zh: RABS / 隔離器：PtC-12 提供細節；TR70 提供框架
blocks.en: RABS / isolators: PtC-12 provides the details; TR70 provides the framework

blocks.zh: 觸發場景：EM 嚴重超標、設施翻修、產品切換
blocks.en: Trigger scenarios: serious EM excursions, facility renovation, product changeover

blocks.zh: 驗證要求：場所特異性，每次需獨立評估
blocks.en: Validation requirements: site-specific, each case needs independent assessment

blocks.zh: 法規連結
blocks.en: Regulatory Links

blocks.zh: 美國：FDA 2004 無菌指引 + 21 CFR 211.42(c)
blocks.en: US: FDA 2004 aseptic guidance + 21 CFR 211.42(c)

blocks.zh: 歐盟：EU GMP Annex 1 (2022 修訂版) + Chapter 3/5
blocks.en: EU: EU GMP Annex 1 (2022 revision) + Chapters 3/5

blocks.zh: 藥典：USP <1072>、ISO 14644、ISO 14698
blocks.en: Pharmacopeia and standards: USP <1072>, ISO 14644, ISO 14698

blocks.zh: PDA 姊妹文件：TR13（EM）、TR29（清潔驗證）、PtC-12（RABS）
blocks.en: PDA sister documents: TR13 (EM), TR29 (cleaning validation), PtC-12 (RABS)

blocks.zh: 一句話總結 TR70： 一個完整的製藥 CDMO C&D 程序，是一個「選藥有據（科學 + 法規）、操作有序（SOP + 排程）、驗證有數（效力測試 + EM 數據）、人員有訓（training + competency）、異常有應（偏差 + CAPA）」的閉環管理系統——TR70 提供了建立這個閉環所需的全部知識基礎。
blocks.en: TR70 in one sentence: A complete pharmaceutical CDMO C&D program is a closed-loop management system with "disinfectant selection that is justified (science + regulation), operations that are orderly (SOPs + scheduling), validation backed by data (efficacy testing + EM data), personnel who are trained (training + competency), and deviations that are answered (deviation + CAPA)". TR70 provides all the knowledge needed to build this closed loop.
